note: The board film for agents (14 October 2026). Every name and number on screen is made up. build-boardfilm.py renders the film's page from this file; voice-lines.py voices the lines and times the scenes.

scenes.headline: The board, for agents
scenes.sub: Your clients, your calls, and what counts
scenes.line: This is the client transition board, as an agent sees it. Your clients, your calls, and what counts.

scenes.headline: Your number, your password
scenes.line: Open Ricky Rampersad branch dot com, slash orphan management, on a phone or a laptop. Sign in with your agent number, or your first name, and your password. The device keeps you signed in until you press Sign out.

scenes.headline: Check it every day
scenes.line: Your list shows every client named to you, from the board or from Salesforce. A naming in Salesforce sends no e-mail. So check your list every day.

scenes.headline: Everything before you dial
scenes.line: Open a client to see their numbers, where they live, their family, what they told us, and why we are calling.

scenes.headline: Press Log call
scenes.line: Call the client. Then press Log call. Choose what happened: called, met, no answer, declined or closed. Write one line for the file, and save.

scenes.headline: Say more on the file
scenes.line: To say more, open history, tasks and comments. Write your comment, and post it. It stays on the client's file, where the branch reads it.

scenes.headline: Three ways it counts

rows.b: A call you log on the board
rows.i: called, met, no answer, declined or closed

rows.i: the field on the policy record
does not show on the board

scenes.line: Your progress counts when you log the call, write a comment, or fill in the Campaign Feedback Update in Salesforce. A note in Chatter alone does not show.

scenes.eyebrow: The clock starts at the naming
scenes.headline: Two days to a conversation
scenes.line: The branch tracks how many days each client has waited, and how many conversations you have had. The aim is a conversation in the first two days, and a meeting soon after.

scenes.headline: The bar moves
scenes.line: When you log it, the branch sees it on the Agents tab. The bar moves, and the red flag clears.

scenes.headline: Call in two days. Log it the same day. Meet the client.
